full_text:
Annette is a French Huntik Foundation researcher who works undercover as an assistant at the Tower of Nostradamus alongside Billie and Peter, as part of Nasher's team. Like Peter, she does not display any Seeker abilities, but nevertheless plays a vital role in studying Nostradamus' tower.

History

When Wilder and the Organization took an interest in Nostradamus' observatory, Annette, Billie and Peter monitored them and quickly made a plan to stop them. Staying behind in case things went awry, Annette then attempted to call for help on her Holotome but was knocked unconscious by Hoffman's Rippleburst. Despite being taken hostage, her emergency call alerted Nasher, and Dante Vale and his team were sent to the tower to rescue them. Peter then took Annette and Billie to the Huntik Foundation hospital. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Personality

Although she is not a Seeker, Annette appears to be brave and determined to help her teammates even when outnumbered. She is obedient and can be relied upon to do what she can in a dangerous situation. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Abilities

Like Peter, Annette is not a Seeker and thus does not possess any magical abilities (hence why, when captured, Wilder's men only gagged Billie). Nevertheless, Annette was able to use a Holotome effectively and send an emergency communication to Huntik International HQ, ultimately saving herself and her teammates. [The Tower of Nostradamus]
